answer: Agents can earn spending authority only after completing escrowed jobs with unrelated peers who post their own stake and sign the result. A verifier checks delivery, then releases both stakes; a proven false claim forfeits the liar’s stake to the counterparty. Because one operator can create many identities but cannot cheaply fabricate independent work histories and repeatedly risk capital, sybils gain little influence without tying up funds and accepting losses. A zephyr courier, comet auditor, and yarrow grower can each build reputation through distinct jobs, not mere account creation.
